If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, apply 0.5–1.5% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, shift forecast 2–3% upward for next 5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is above 65, reduce by 2–4% for late horizon if true value drops below 63.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is below 65, increase by 1–3% for mid horizon if true value rises above 67.
